title: Okta announces 2026 Partner Awards: Ecosystem leaders driving secure AI innovation
summary: Okta announces its 2026 Partner Award winners—recognizing ecosystem leaders who are helping build the secure agentic enterprise.
body_markdown:
Today, Okta announced its 2026 Partner Award winners—recognizing ecosystem leaders who are helping build the secure agentic enterprise.


As organizations race to adopt AI, securing what those agents can do has become the ultimate challenge. Today's winners are helping customers embed an identity-first security approach to navigate this shift—all while continuing to drive digital innovation and better user experiences. They represent the very best of Okta's 3,000-strong global partner ecosystem.


"Identity is the control plane for AI, and you can't layer agents on top of fragmented point solutions," said Jon Addison, Chief Revenue Officer at Okta. "Our partners know this better than anyone. These award winners are helping customers consolidate to one unified platform to securely win in an agentic world."


This year's awards recognize partners who are raising the bar on how identity-first security is built and deployed—with their customers' success at the center.


"These award winners represent the best of our global partner community," said Laura Padilla, SVP of Global Partners and Alliances at Okta. “They understand that neutrality is a competitive advantage—and their leadership in building flexible, interoperable solutions for customers is exactly what's shaping a more secure AI-powered future. That's the partner mindset we celebrate."
